EQUIP-R1.detail: PreciseTextSpan now reports measured vs estimated OCR word boundaries. ValuePixelsPreserved is true only for measured boundaries. Estimated merged-word regions are preserved as a plan and refused again by composition (equipment-field-boundary-estimated). The 48-marker regression checks the entire value region, not just its centre.

EQUIP-R2.detail: FitEquipmentFieldFont no longer loops/shrinks per label. Every field uses the panel typography's final FieldSize; a key that cannot fit keeps the original. Real GDI+ checks confirm 智力 and 物理防御力 both use the same 16px panel size, with a too-wide key preserved instead of painted at 14px.

EQUIP-R1a.detail: PreciseTextSpan now maps raw word offsets instead of normalized characters, so separate sign words (Unicode minus and ASCII minus) are included in the measured value box. The value span is strict about clipped words; a key word may only ignore attached punctuation. The WDEF: − 5 and WDEF : - 5 variants protect the complete sign+digit region, and composition rejects estimated boundaries.

EQUIP-R3a.detail: Key-start filtering permits INT after an OCR digit O only when the preceding run is a complete numeric value immediately following a previous confirmed field, so STR:+1OINT:+3 parses STR=+1O and INT=+3 while POINT is not split. Parsing, planning and painting regressions cover the combined form.

EQUIP-R3b.detail: The whole segment between the previous field and a following key must match the canonical numeric-value grammar; a digit-containing prefix such as +1PO is rejected. Outside an equipment panel, any unconsumed prose clears the parse unless a strong equipment anchor exists. Both key and value boxes must be measured; a right-side value box cannot upgrade a clipped-letter key. STR:+1POINT:+3, STR:+1FOOINT:+3 and STR:+1PO INT:+3 plan/paint nothing, while STR:+1OINT:+3 still parses and paints both fields.

EQUIP-R3.detail: Key matches are collected before value extraction. Each value range is bounded by the next confirmed field start, so STR+5INT+3 parses STR=+5 and INT=+3, while legitimate OCR tolerance such as +1O remains. Parsing, planning and painting regressions cover the no-space and spaced forms.
